subject.title: feat(nodes): route alerts to the active computer

question: Should active-computer identity become a gateway-wide model-context fact and node connection alerts become gateway-owned behavior for every node transport?
rationale: The feature changes core protocol, prompt context, notification ownership, and cross-transport behavior, while the paired issue and PR carry a protected maintainer signal.

options.title: Adopt the gateway design
options.body: Keep gateway-owned activity ranking and routing, fix the current delivery defects, require real multi-Mac proof, and then land.

options.title: Ship observability only
options.body: Expose active-node presence through node APIs and CLI while deferring model prompt projection and automatic alert routing.

options.title: Decline the feature
options.body: Retain the existing notification behavior and close the paired issue and PR.

recommendation.title: Adopt the gateway design
recommendation.body: Keep gateway-owned activity ranking and routing, fix the current delivery defects, require real multi-Mac proof, and then land.

likelyOwner.reason: This person is assigned and has the strongest merged history across the affected macOS and gateway-node surfaces.
